products.name: High Lift Scissor Pallet Truck

text.head: Hydraulic High Lift Scissor Pallet Truck combines the advantages of hand pallet truck & scissor lift, allowing the operator to position the pallet at any desired working heights.
Single stage cylinder gives uniform lifting capacity & avoids risk of dangerous dropping of second stage cylinder.

Once forks are lifted above 300 mm, side stoppers touches the ground and lift wheels near pump in air making scissor pallet truck stationary. This gives stability & safety when pallet is lifted at height.
Robust in construction with additional ribs on welded joints for better strength.
Excellent manoeuvrability with bigger diameter steering wheels, Dia 200 x 50 mm.
Reliable hydraulic system with single cartridge valve with CO2 welded pump.
All wheels are provided with sealed ball bearings for smooth & effortless movement of pallet truck under heavy loads.
Pivoted joints are provided with brass bushes to avoid wear & tear of pins to give trouble free long life with stability.
Provided with precisely controlled needle valve for smooth controlled lowering under heavy load.
Maintenance free pump unit, strong body, low cost spares with easy availability & prompt service improves overall performance.

lines: C channel & is fitted to upright by bolts. Base plate is provided with holes for anchor fastener for securing upright to ground.

Horizontal & Diagonal Members - These are single piece m. s. Sheet 1.2 mm thick bent to form C channel & are bolted to uprights to form a rigid vertical frame.
Horizontal Load Members - These are single piece m. s. sheet bent to form
lines: C channel for strength & two such C channels are welded to form a box type horizontal load members.

text.head: Column Guards C Type - C Type Column Guards are provided as protection to uprights in corner areas & traffic ways against fork lift impact. It is made of sheet bent & 200 mm in height with holes at bottom for anchor fastener.
